programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Titien. You will discover his labour with Pastoral concert, The resurrection of Christ or Venus with organist.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Georges Seurat. You will discover his labour with « Ile de France » landscape, Study for « a Sunday afternoon at the grande jatte », Study for « La grande jatte ».

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Jean-François Millet (1814 - 1875) was a 19th-century French realist painter, pastellist, engraver and draughtsman. He is best known for his realistic rural scenes.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: An emblematic figure in Europe at the turn of the 18th century, this corporal who became Emperor of France unleashed the imagination of artists from whom he commissioned many works. Discover the victorious young “Bonaparte at the Pont d’Arcole” immortalised by the Antoine-Jean Gros in 1796. Observe also the portraits of all the guests present during the “Coronation of Napoleon” and his triumphant gesture as he crowned his wife Josephine in David’s masterpiece displayed in the Louvre Museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: A cross between Taylorism and Bauhaus, the Van Nelle factory in Rotterdam, built between 1926 and 1931, is a gigantic factory where tobacco, coffee and tea were processed until the 1980s. The image is not that of a simple building, but that of a great machine, a great liner clad in glass and metal. Entirely glazed façades reveal the internal structure of the buildings, allowing workers to work in daylight. All movement is by sight through the glassed-in staircases and walkways - transparency is both a writing effect and a surveillance tool. Built by architects Jan Brickman and Leen Van der Vlugt, under the supervision of Van Nelle boss Kees Van der Leuw, the factory is the most important and accomplished achievement of the modern movement in industrial architecture.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Rembrandt at the National Gallery, London & Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Lucian Freud, l'un des peintres britanniques les plus célèbres de notre époque, est également l'un des rares artistes du XXe siècle à s'être représenté dans un autoportrait avec une telle constance. Ses autoportraits donnent un aperçu fascinant à la fois de sa personnalité et de son évolution en tant que peintre, depuis son premier portrait peint en 1939 jusqu'au dernier. Grâce à des entretiens fascinants avec d'anciens modèles, des amis et d'éminents experts, ce documentaire intensément captivant révèle l'œuvre d'un maître qui représente une étude captivante sur la dynamique du vieillissement et le processus d'autoreprésentation.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Le musée d’Orsay, qui fut d'abord une gare construite pour l'Exposition universelle de 1900, abrite la production artistique du monde occidental sur la période de 1848 à 1914. De nombreux courants artistiques y sont présentés : académisme, réalisme, symbolisme, Art nouveau, et bien sur l’impressionnisme avec des œuvres et des artistes incontournables tels que l’Olympia de Manet, le Bal du moulin de la galette de Renoir, l’Etoile de Degas ou le Cirque de Seurat.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux amies de la scène et de la télévision, Ruth Madoc et Su Pollard, connues pour leurs apparitions dans la sitcom Hi-De-Hi, partent à la chasse aux antiquités avec Phil Serrell et Raj Bisram. Partis de Monmouth, ville frontalière du Pays de Galles, ils se rendent à Congleton, dans le Cheshire, pour une vente aux enchères.Ruth découvre également l'incroyable infirmière du XIXe siècle - et ce n'est pas Florence Nightingale - tandis que Su visite l'ancienne ville romaine de Caerleon et trouve le temps d'affronter Phil dans un amphithéâtre.Et Su tente de résoudre un vieux mystère... Phil porte-t-il une perruque ?

programme.title: Van Gogh: The Real Story
programme.desc: Perhaps the most well-known fact about Vincent's troubled life is that he cuts his ear. Dive into the horrifying story of what it is that inspires him to do something so drastic.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous nous intéresserons à l’artiste Robert Combas. Sa peinture est faite de libertés : elle parle de la société, de la violence, de la sexualité, de la souffrance des gens, de leurs petits bonheurs, de leur petitesse, de leur grandeur… Il s’inspire du rock dont il est un fin amateur, des images populaires des livres d’enfance, des manuels scolaires, et de tout ce qui fait une culture populaire accessible à tous.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Les impressionnistes - et l'homme qui les a créés
programme.desc: Ce sont les artistes les plus populaires du monde. Les œuvres de Cézanne, Monet, Degas et leurs compatriotes représentent des richesses inestimables. Mais qui étaient-ils vraiment ? Comment et pourquoi ont-ils révolutionné l’histoire de l’art ? Qu’est-ce qui se cache derrière leur succès intemporel ? Pour répondre à ces questions, le documentaire a obtenu un accès unique à une grande exposition mettant l’accent sur le collectionneur d’art parisien du 19ème siècle, Paul Durand-Ruel, l’expert des Impressionnistes qui prit la décision courageuse d’exposer les Impressionnistes à New York en 1886 et ainsi introduire la société américaine à la peinture française moderne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In each episode of the decisive moment, we welcome a photographer whom we have asked to select three photos that have marked their life and their career. Whether they are reporters, portraitists or fashion photographers, they all have the same passion and will share it with us.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'humoriste et animateur Jim Moir et sa femme Nancy Sorrell partent en road trip dans le Kent aujourd'hui.Mieux connu sous le nom de Vic Reeves, Jim apporte sa touche d'humour unique à l'achat d'antiquités. De son côté, Nancy, mannequin et présentatrice télé, sait aussi marchander et elle est très compétitive ! Le couple est accompagné par les experts Charlie Ross et Thomas Plant.Soyez attentif au don surprenant de Jim pour deviner l’âge de presque tout, à Dixon traversant les chutes du Niagara et à une leçon de navigation par longitude.Et surtout, la mystérieuse Mme Parker fera-t-elle son apparition à la vente aux enchères ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: Depuis 5 ans, l'équipe de Masterpiece se fait prier pour réaliser une reconstitution de la célèbre œuvre 'La Tour de Babel' de Pieter Bruegel l'Ancien. En raison de sa complexité et de sa taille (avec environ 1033 personnages sur pas moins de 9 doubles étages), ils n'ont jamais osé. Mais cette année, l'équipe a relevé le gant et est parvenue à ses fins, grâce à son extrême persévérance.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: Where do we start when we want to talk about such a famous painting as Velázquez “Las Meninas”? There is an incredibly huge bibliography on this painting, to the point that it is almost utopian to think or hope we can document ourselves on everything in and about it... From the late 1800s to the early 2000s, dozens of books have come out all over the world specifically and solely devoted to this one, single painting. A parallel literary current has even developed around the “enigmas” and “mysteries” connected with “Las Meninas”.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.sub-title: Piero Della Francesca, The Montefeltro Altarpiece
programme.desc: For us today the Montefeltro Altarpiece, preserved in the Brera Art Gallery in Milan, is the “Altarpiece by Piero” par excellence. It is surprising to learn however, that until the late 1800s no one would ever have dreamed of attributing this impressive masterpiece to the hand of Piero della Francesca. For long centuries it was a deeply-rooted belief that the painter of the work was a certain Bartolomeo Corradini, a friar-painter known by the funny nickname of Fra Carnevale. It is in this guise that the Montefeltro Altarpiece came to Brera in 1811 and all the catalogues of the Milan Art Gallery repeated Fra Carnevale’s name until the end of that century. Piero della Francesca was simply forgotten... His name and his works ended up literally in the dust of oblivion until they disappeared from the horizon of history... His critical resurrection happened however, in the early 1900s, the century in which the Master painter wielded a powerful influence on the art of the first decades….

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: What is the Arab world? It is not easy to define this expression as it brings together territories as immense as they are diverse, cultures which share common traits but which each have their specificities. The Museum of the Institute of the Arab World endeavors to offer a vision of this world as rich as it is diverse, through numerous archaeological pieces, treasures of history and culture. But also, thanks to contemporary works, which help to tell what the Arab world is today, in a world shaken by cultural globalization and the questioning of the identities inherent in our modern society.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Lucas Cranach l’Ancien (v. 1472-1553) est un artiste majeur de la Renaissance germanique, actif à Wittenberg dans la première moitié du XVIe s. Peintre officiel de Frédéric le Sage, prince électeur de Saxe, il est proche du réformateur Martin Luther. Au-delà des thèmes bibliques, il s’intéresse particulièrement à la représentation du nu féminin, comme dans l’Adam et Eve de Besançon ou les fameuses Trois Grâces, récemment acquises par le musée du Louvre grâce à un appel aux dons.Bonne visite !

programme.desc: Initiated by Richard Copans and Stan Neumann in 1994, the Architectures collection is comprised of 67 episodes, each focusing on a single building from classical, modern, or contemporary architecture. These "architecture masterclasses" are a magnificent mixture of rigor, pleasure and intelligence.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous irons à la rencontre de l’artiste Annette Messager. Ses créations bousculent la scène contemporaine depuis presque 50 ans. Elle est l’un des plus grands artistes français récompensée par un lion d’or à la Biennale de Venise en 2005. Elle emploi tissu, et objets du quotidien pour représenter l’intime. Mais elle reste aussi une artiste engagée. Installée dans la banlieue populaire de Paris, Annette Messager nous reçoit dans son atelier.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: British Museum is a museum of human history and culture, located in London, United Kingdom. It contains over seven million of the world's most important objects.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Tout à la fois peintre et diplomate, Pierre-Paul Rubens (1577-1640) fut un personnage essentiel dans l’Europe artistique du XVIIe siècle. Il créa de vastes compositions pour les familles princières d’alors, comme le cycle sur la vie de Marie de Médicis, aujourd’hui conservé au musée du Louvre. Il incarne la veine baroque du Nord de l’Europe, développant un style tout en mouvement et aux touches colorées lumineuses, comme dans l’Enlèvement des filles de Leucippe exposé à Munich.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: La maison Unal a été conçue par Claude Häusermann-Costy et construite par Joël Unal entre 1972 et 2008. Monsieur et Madame Unal rêvent, comme de nombreux Français, d’habiter une maison individuelle. C’est un programme classique, la maison de famille, qui aboutit à un résultat singulier – une maison bulle construite sans aucun angle droit. La maison Unal s’inscrit dans le courant architectural que l’on appelle "L’Architecture Sculpture". Pour tous les volumes de la maison, une seule technique de construction : le voile de béton sans coffrage, posé à la main sur une armature métallique.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Après deux ans d’exposition itinérante, en 2015 "La Jeune Fille à la perle” est retournée au musée Mauritshuis de La Haye. Du haut de ses 350 ans, l’éternelle Jeune Fille a toujours su conserver son aura de mystère et son charme. La preuve, c’est le nombre de curieux (1,2 millions) qui ont accouru pour l’apercevoir lors de son séjour au Japon. Le documentaire cherche à découvrir les nombreuses énigmes de cet extraordinaire tableau et de son créateur mystérieux - Vermeer. Qui était cette fille ? Pourquoi et comment Vermeer a-t-il peint ce tableau ? Venez voyager dans le temps pour découvrir Johannes Vermeer, visiter le charmant musée de La Haye et répondre à toutes ces questions.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Qui était Frida Kahlo ? Voyagez dans la vie d'une véritable icône, découvrez son art et la vérité qui se cache derrière sa vie souvent mouvementée. La combinaison d'interviews, de commentaires et d'une exploration détaillée de l'art de Kahlo, offre un trésor de couleurs et un festin de vitalité. Ce documentaire personnel et intime offre un accès privilégié à ses œuvres, et met en lumière sa créativité fébrile, sa résilience et sa soif inégalée pour la vie.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Paul Sérusier spent his entire summer of 1888 painting with Paul Gauguin in Pont-Aven, Brittany. This master of colour gave invaluable advice to the young Sérusier, who was part of the new generation of painters known as the Post-Impressionists. The Impressionists favoured the visual sensation of the motif, but they had not broken with the illusionist rendering of nature.

programme.desc: Francisco Goya, considéré comme le fondateur de l’art moderne, est l’artiste espagnol le plus acclamé. En plus d’observer avec talent la vie et le passé mouvementé de l’Espagne, c’est un portraitiste doué et un commentateur social par excellence. Avec Goya, l’art du portrait atteint de nouveaux sommets. Cette exposition majeure de la National Gallery de Londres remet son génie en lumière. À travers une formidable collection d’oeuvres uniques et de lettres de Goya, nous analysons l’homme lui-même et le monde qu’il peignait.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

But one day he decided to go on a trip and leave it all behind.

programme.desc: Strictly Come Dancing’s Zoe Ball and Ian Waite are quickstepping their way across the south West of England in a bid to turn a profit at auction in Hampshire. Experts Margie Cooper and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to guide. Paul shares a secret with Zoe about buying antique hair brushes. Ian, though, offers dancing lessons to dealers to secure a discount. Lordy! Zoe also hears how one village became world famous for lace production while Ian ends up meeting a giant horse with its own boat.

Les chefs sont accompagnés de David Harper et Natasha Raskin.Partant de Dundee, ils descendent la côte est de l’Écosse jusqu’au village de Rosewell, dans le Midlothian, pour une vente aux enchères. Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.sub-title: Johannes Vermeer - Girl with a Pearl Earring
programme.desc: Vermeer’s ‘Girl with the Pearl Earring’ was chosen by the public as the most beautiful painting in the Netherlands. It is also called the Mona Lisa of the low countries. The artwork has an incredibly beautiful light and almost inscrutable build-up of paint layers. What technique did Vermeer use to achieve this? The course of light and sharpness is unprecedented for its time. And is the pearl a pearl? The team will try to unravel these secrets by re-creating the painting with all the technology of today and knowledge of the past. Masterpiece faces many challenges in the search for Vermeer's secret.

programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

Partis de Monmouth, ville frontalière du Pays de Galles, ils se rendent à Congleton, dans le Cheshire, pour une vente aux enchères.Ruth découvre également l'incroyable infirmière du XIXe siècle - et ce n'est pas Florence Nightingale - tandis que Su visite l'ancienne ville romaine de Caerleon et trouve le temps d'affronter Phil dans un amphithéâtre.Et Su tente de résoudre un vieux mystère... Phil porte-t-il une perruque ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.desc: A challenging and strengthening sequence, Revolve and Evolve seeks to reveal moments of relaxation in which truths can be more readily accessed. Use this sequence to detoxify, build confidence and restore a sense of balance and wellbeing to take off the mat and into the rest of your day.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, c'est au tour d'Emmanuele, un Montois de 29 ans, de relever le défi. Ce gérant d'une boutique vintage a un style bien à lui. Pour Emmanuele, le secret d'une bonne déco se cache dans la précision. Voyons comment ce perfectionniste à l’extrême s’en sort avec notre thème “jungle urbaine”.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tendre et savoureux, l’agneau tient une place prépondérante dans la cuisine festive mais aussi dans celle de tous les jours. Du Pays Basque au Cotentin en passant par Paris, Julie part donc sur les routes de France à la découverte des différentes races et types d'élevage existant à travers le pays. Il faut dire que la France a l'une des productions les plus variées au monde. Il existe plus d'une quarantaine de races répertoriées en 5 catégories : précoces, d’herbage, rustiques, mérinos et laitières. Mais plus qu’à la race, c’est à la façon dont ils sont alimentés qui intéresse les fins connaisseurs. Julie nous fait découvrir ses producteurs et cuisiniers de ce met raffiné !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Avec son amie Myriam, Luana Belmondo prépare deux recettes à base de safran. Au programme : orecchiette (petites pâtes italiennes) avec de la saucisse, et lotte au citron confit avec sa purée d’asperges.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana accueille Héloïse Brion, créatrice de "Miss Maggie's Kitchen

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Ces reportages sont surtout l'occasion pour Yann Arthus-Bertrand de dresser un état des lieux de la planète et de dénoncer certains comportements humains, à l'origine de dégradations environnementales et climatiques dramatiques, voire irréversibles. Direction Tokyo puis le Kenya vers un refuge animalier. Puis vers le mont Fuji pour apprendre à y vivre ainsi que de tout le plastique qui encombre les mers. Les reportages aborderont des produits du quotidien, choisis pour leurs pratiques de production destructrices à la fois pour les hommes et pour l'environnement.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: To better understand the role of these explosive mountains located all over the world, on land or under the sea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand goes to Italy, the country with the most active volcanoes in Europe. Accompanied by volcano expert Jacques-Marie Bardintzeff, the photographer meets those people who have chosen to live with « their » volcano, in spite of the dangers involved in this kind of proximity.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: We end up at Yellowstone National Park in the United States, it is located in the first natural park created in the world. In Peru, the Amazon rainforest is suffering from massive deforestation. The desert on Beijing's doorstep is regularly hit by sandstorms. Some experts predict that the Chinese capital could be threatened by deserts within a hundred years. In Montana, American agricultural productivity has an ecological and human cost. Engineer Marc Dufumier explains how mechanisation is undermining the natural balance. In Brazil, agrofuels have made it possible to reduce dependence on oil, cut urban air pollution and even limit greenhouse gas emissions. In Los Angeles, human activities have disrupted the greenhouse effect and exacerbated it. Today, the Earth is heating up.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: In Florida, the Everglades swamp is being restored at great expense. 15 billion dollars are being invested over thirty years to save the water supply of the entire region. In California, on the crests of the Tehachapi hills, the world's largest wind farm is being discovered. In China, the fermentation of excrement produces gas, mainly methane, which, when burned, is transformed into energy called biogas. In California, the Taft oil field was discovered, one of the largest in the world: nearly 10,000 wells on over 52,000 hectares. Then Haiti fights to save itself from deforestation. In Utah, Salt Lake City is a good example of how we live today: there are 37 cities in the world with more than 8 million inhabitants. In the Eure-et-Loir region of France, they decided to build the ideal house to give a house that saves 85% of energy.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Coconut milk is easy to cook, and can be used with a wide range of ingredients, from stews and soups to sweet recipes.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Quel bonheur de retrouver ce fruit printanier ! Les fraises redonnent des couleurs à nos assiettes et nous apportent une bonne dose de vitamines et d’antioxydants. Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo nous dévoile deux recettes sucrées autour des fraises.

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week it’s the semi-finals and the competition hits a new level with our four remaining pairs all competing at the same time to create amazing gardens at the Glenfield Hospital in Leicester. Separated into 2 semi-finals, each with their own brief, the pressure increases as the plots get bigger and the budget goes up to £7500, whilst still only having 48 hours to complete them. In semi-final 1 Tamara and Kate take on husband and wife team Catherine and James Burrage where they’re challenge to create a garden for the staff of the hospital to use. While in semi-final 2 Scottish pair James and Stuart take on the youngest pair in the competition, recent graduates Millie and Max, as they’re challenged to create gardens for the hospital’s patients.

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Crafting
programme.desc: Michelle Ackerley, Rosie Wolfenden and four passionate hobby crafters head to the Haddon Hall Craft Fair in Bakewell, Derbyshire. Brian loves turning old furniture into new pieces, so Rosie offers tips on how to photograph and present his pieces for sale. James and Bridget have an alpaca farm and make yarn by spinning. Bridget learns about natural dyes, while James rushes to get production running with his sock-making machine. Mum-of-two Tracey is a paper crafter who makes original pieces for friends and family, but she urgently needs advice on pricing.

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week it’s the last of the heats and sees a pair of new kids on the block taking on a more experienced and established pair of garden designers. For Millie Souter from London and Max Parker-Smith from Surrey it’s a huge challenge as both of them have only recently graduated in garden design from the prestigious Inchbald Garden Design College so have limited experience of actually creating gardens. Making things even tougher, it’s also the first time the friends have worked together. Opposing them is Nicola Bailey Gibson and Viv Seccombe who bring years of experience designing and building private gardens and award-winning show gardens. The challenge our pairs face is to create amazing gardens for Focus Birmingham Day Care Centre which offers activities and support to people with severe visual and physical disabilities. And they have to do this is just 2 days and on a budget of £5000.

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Crafting
programme.desc: Three hobby crafters present their works for the first time at Brancepeth Castle Craft Fair in Durham. Occupational therapist Olivia dyes her own yarn and produces hand-woven pieces, ex-builder Neil makes quirky metal ornaments and Wendi now makes her own glass pieces uses the art of fusing - and for the fair she even learns the art of glass blowing.

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week’s heat sees professional teams from opposite ends of the UK compete as they’re challenged to create amazing spaces in just 2 days on a budget of £5000, for the Care for Veterans’ care home in Worthing, a specialist care home for elderly and disabled military veterans. Experienced garden designers and builders, James Hutchison and Stuart Gibson have travelled to the South Coast all the way from London. While their opponents, Manoj Maldé and Mark Holman, garden designers who collaborate on show gardens together, have only had to travel from Hertfordshire and Kent. With a brief that includes making sure the gardens are wheelchair friendly and low maintenance the teams come up with very different designs. James and Stuart are faced with a potentially disastrous problem they aren’t used to dealing with back in Scotland. But can they resolve it in time and finish their garden?

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: La semaine touche à sa fin. Céline, Aurélie, Gaëtan et Emmanuele vont faire face aux critiques de leurs adversaires. Mais surtout, les propriétaires vont enfin rentrer chez eux et découvrir leur pièce entièrement redécorée. Que penseront-ils de leur nouvel intérieur ? Quels points vont-ils attribuer ? Car leurs notes peuvent tout faire basculer et renverser le classement actuel. Qui remportera la compétition ? Qui repartira avec les 2000 € et le titre d’As de la déco de la semaine ?

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie reprend la route à bord de sa petite voiture rouge pour faire honneur à l’un de ses fruits favoris : la châtaigne. Julie ira à la rencontre de plusieurs producteurs en Ardèche, cuisinera la soupe traditionnelle de la région aux côtés de la pétillante Marithé. Elle fera aussi la recette des marrons glacés maison, avant de filer en Corse pour travailler la farine de châtaignes et les feuilles de son arbre. Ce périple s’achèvera comme toujours avec une recette de chef astucieuse et cette-fois ce sera Claude Brioude qui s’y collera ! Ce chef aime bousculer les codes et travaillera la châtaigne avec le poisson, deux produits de saison que l’on n’a pas forcément l’habitude de marier.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous emmène en Bretagne sud et plus précisément dans le quartier maritime du Guilvinec pour faire avec vous la route du poisson depuis les filets jusqu’à vos assiettes. Le Guilvinec a beau être le premier port de pêche artisanale français, tous les bords de mers de l’hexagone réservent de bons produits de saison. Julie remonte donc en voiture pour découvrir dans le sud un certain nombre de poissons d’élevage dans une ferme aquacole en Méditerranée, tout en cuisinant le bar à Noirmoutier, la lotte dans le Nord et même le cabillaud dans l’immense marché de Rungis. Julie a challengé le Chef Olivier Bellin installé à Plomodiern dans le Finistère, pour qu’il cuisine un poisson méconnu : la vieille.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Discover an Italian culinary staple: ravioli. Luana Belmondo, accompanied by her son Alessandro, makes her recipe for ricotta arugula ravioli with artichoke and almond sauce. The duo also prepare choco ravioli stuffed with pistachio custard and strawberry coulis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo gives you ideas for recipes that are easy to prepare using a wok! Thanks to this cooking method, you can create delicious, quick recipes using leftovers from your fridge or cupboard.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized man's life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. In his crazy race for always more production, Man didn't manage to preserve this precious energy that took million years for the Earth to give out. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. It's today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. While all our economies are based on the petrol barrel's price, we'll have to learn to do without oil within 20, 30 or 100 years. What will be the consequences? What are the solutions at stake? This new episode of Earth From Above attempts to answer these questions. From China to Benin, including Azerbaijan, Belgium and Canada, Earth From Above takes us on a new trip.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Pour mieux comprendre le rôle de ces montagnes explosives disséminées un peu partout sur la terre ou sous les océans, Yann Arthus-Bertrand s'est rendu en Italie, pays qui compte le plus grand nombre de volcans en activité d'Europe. Accompagné du volcanologue Jacques-Marie Bardintzeff, le photographe est allé à la rencontre de ceux qui ont choisi de vivre avec « leur » volcan, malgré les dangers que cette cohabitation comporte.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Feeding the family is the concern of billions of people every day on the planet and it has been completely forgotten. We will also see that we, as consumers, can change things by changing our eating habits because our health and sustainable development depend on it. We fly over Paris to discover the cultivated plains, the intensive breeding in the Beauce, the pesticides in Guadeloupe and the green Camargue where the ecosystem is threatened, until India where the limits of the green revolution are reached.

programme.title: Earth from Above

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pour les paresseux et tous ceux qui n’ont pas le temps, Luana Belmondo propose deux petites recettes simples et efficaces. Découvrez son pain à l'ail et au fromage, et ses spaghettis à l'ail.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo met l'avocat à l'honneur, ce fruit originaire du Mexique qui présente de nombreux bienfaits pour notre santé. Elle nous propose une recette de gambas à la purée de concombres et avocats, ainsi qu'une panna cotta à l'avocat accompagnée de sa salade de fraises.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: How can we reconcile the development needed to sustain the lives of nearly seven billion people with the protection of the Earth's natural resources? Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team have chosen Gabon to continue their survey of the planet. We'll be discovering the Kongou Falls, the Langoué clearing with their elephant in Gabon. Then in Colombia, we will go on the island of Malpelo with their shark. Back to Gabon we will discover the Minkébé National Park and the bats in Franceville. We will also go to India in Hyderabad, which has convinced farmers to use no pesticides and no GMOs in their cultivation.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The incredible diversity of flora and fauna, the fight against climate change, the balance between growth and sustainable development: these are all battles being fought on five continents. Yann Arthus-Bertrand takes us on this expedition. We're off to Gabon to discover the Ivindo National Park and Port-Gentil, then on to Sri Lanka in Kandi. Back to Gabon we go to Libreville, then Lambaréné to talk about turtles and the health of the local people. Finally, off to Dhaka-Bangladesh.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Dans ce volet, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lève le voile sur les produits achetés par les hommes. Presque tous nos achats ont une incidence directe sur notre environnement. Direction la Japon pour parler de l’impact des nouvelles technologies, puis la république du Congo à Bukavu pour la récolte du coltan. Comment notre consommation totale affecte-t-elle l'environnement ? Quelles marques permanentes imposons-nous à notre planète ? Comment différencier les achats utiles des achats inutiles ?

programme.title: Dyrenes Fight Club
programme.desc: Livet i villmarken er en konstant konkurranse om å drepe, og noen dyr går langt for å overleve og erobre. Vær vitne til hva som skjer når dyr kjemper om makten.

programme.title: Dyrenes Fight Club

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol: Høydepunkter
programme.desc: I denne spesialepisoden av "The Incredible Dr. Pol" er Michigans mest pålitelige veterinærer alltid på vakt, for dyrenes nødssituasjoner venter ikke på åpningstidene. Fra en katt som er blitt angrepet av en vaskebjørn til en gris som får problemer under en fødsel, tar teamet seg av et bredt spekter av akutte pasienter. Dr. Pol rykker til og med ut til en hest i livsfare og redder synet til en chihuahua etter et slagsmål. Når dyr havner i nød døgnet rundt, går disse veterinærene straks til verks, improviserer og løser problemer på sparket. Uansett hvilken krise det dreier seg om, skynder dr. Pol og hans engasjerte team seg til stedet for å gi livreddende behandling til både store og små dyr.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol: Høydepunkter
programme.desc: I denne spesialepisoden behandler teamet ved Pols veterinærklinikk kjære familiedyr. Hunden Kilo trenger en komplisert øyeoperasjon for å gjenvinne synet, katten Ziggy lider av en alvorlig urinveisblokkering, og hesten Jack har en farlig blokkering i halsen som raskt blir et stort problem. I mellomtiden håper dr. Brenda på å finne ut hvorfor Murphy, en snill labrador, plutselig har sluttet å spise, og dr. Pol jobber raskt for å klippe klørne og nebbene til to livlige araer.

programme.title: Utrolige australia

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Overraskelser kommer i alle former og størrelser. En nymfekakadu har et skjevt nebb og dr. Lisa undersøker en gårdskatts blærelekkasje. Når en chihuahua ankommer timer senere med et akutt øyeproblem, beholder legene fokuset. En alvorlig skjønnhetsfeil dukker opp på en konkurransehund, og en hes hest sliter med å puste. Alle samarbeider for å gjøre Dianes bursdag ekstra spesiell.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.sub-title: Det bøtter på med katter og hunder
programme.desc: En ny sau er på vei til Pols gård, og familien ordner dreneringen i sauehuset. Den kalde vinteren er på vei, så det stinkende stedet må fikses raskt.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Vest i Middelhavet ligger Portugal, med et mangfold av økosystemer som huser et imponerende rikt dyreliv. Mange av artene finnes bare i denne delen av verden og er tett knyttet sammen i et økosystem som gir dyrene grunnlag for å overleve i et til tider krevende landskap. En ildsalamander, som kan bli opptil 50 år gammel, nyter sitt første måltid etter å ha tilbrakt den tørre sommeren i dvale under jorden. Iberiagaupa, en av verdens sjeldneste villkatter, jakter på favorittbyttet sitt, kanin. Kongeørn og rev, som vanligvis er rivaler, tolererer hverandre lenge nok til å dele et bytte. Samtidig forbereder unge pyreneersteinbukker seg på voksenlivet ved å bryne hornene mot hverandre i en imponerende styrkeprøve.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Langs Portugals kyst er livet både vakkert og brutalt for de unike artene som lever der, fra mikroskopisk planteplankton til enorme spermhvaler. Vinkekrabbene kjemper om retten til å pare seg i kystlagunene. Sepiablekksprutenen, en mester i kamuflasje, sniker seg inn på intetanende byttedyr. Storker bygger reir på de bratte klippene langs Atlanterhavskysten og vokter ungene sine mot rovdyr.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz drar til Derbyshire for å redde en 48 år gammel italiensk superbil: en Lamborghini Espada 1971-modell.

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: Richard bringer inn en forretningskonsulent for å gjøre verkstedet mer effektivt, men ikke alle er enige i forandringene. Cogs prøvekjører den nye måten å jobbe på med en klassisk Fiat, men er dette italienske ikonet virkelig verdt å prøve å redde? Corgi ber om tillatelse til å lage en modell av Richards RS2000 – verkstedets aller første restaureringsprosjekt. Dette PR-kuppet blir fort til en potensiell PR-katastrofe. Cogs kjemper for å ferdigstille BMW-en de har holdt på med i over et år. Konsulenten oppdager den virkelige kostnaden bak tepauser, og en invitasjon til Goodwood pirrer Richards racinglyst.

programme.title: Egypts tapte skatter
programme.sub-title: Ramses den store: byggeren av imperiet
programme.desc: I denne episoden følger arkeologer ledetråder for å prøve og låse opp hemmelighetene til Ramses suksess. Banebrytende teknologi brukes til å redde en av Egypts største skatter, mens i en eldgammel by avdekker ett team et skjult palass som ble brukt som Ramses’ private hellige sted. I mellomtiden avdekker en sjaktgraving et potensielt stort funn.

programme.title: Egypts tapte skatter
programme.desc: I denne episoden låser arkeologene opp mysteriene til Egypts mest berømte farao, Tutankhamun. Teknologi avslører metodene til håndverkerne som skapte Tutankhamuns skatter, og vi tar en titt under bandasjene til en 3000 år gammel barnemumie, og avslører overraskende bevis. I mellomtiden gjør et team på jakt etter Tutankhamuns tapte bytte et uventet funn.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: I San Diego finner man amfetamin gjemt i en last med hvitløk. Grensevaktene leter etter partydop blant toalettsakene på flyplassen i Atlanta, og man ser etter falske varer på JFK.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Grensevaktene jakter på narkosmuglere langs kysten og i jungelen i Puerto Rico. I Laredo finner man 60 kg marihuana i griller.

programme.title: Hemmeligheter på havets bunn
programme.desc: Mot slutten av den siste istiden migrerte de første menneskene til Amerika. Enkelte mener at det skjedde på land, men nå ser arkeologene mot kysten. Hva kan et 13 000 år gammelt skjelett funnet i den meksikanske jungelen fortelle oss om disse menneskene og deres verden? Og i en undersjøisk grotte avslører vi den storslåtte historiene om de første menneskene i den nye verden.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: Car SOS drar til Southend for å påta seg et uvanlig oppdrag: en JCB-gravemaskin fra 1978. Kjøretøyet tilhører den tidligere snekkeren Kev. Etter to hjerteinfarkt er han ikke lenger i stand til å ta vare på favoritten sin.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz reiser til Cambridgeshire for å ta seg an Kevs Mk.1 Toyota MR2, en toseters sportsbil som er kjent for sine mange problemer. Eieren, Kev, jobbet i bilbransjen det meste av livet, men alvorlig sykdom gjorde at han ikke kunne fikse den kjære bilen. Kevs familie skrev til Car SOS i håp om at gutta kunne ordne opp.

programme.title: Hitlers siste kamp
programme.desc: I august 1944 nærmer de allierte seg restene av den tyske hæren. Med 100 000 soldater, våpen og stridsvogner skaper de Falaise-lommen. De presser på, men det finnes en åpning i de alliertes forsvarslinje. En liten kanadisk panserbataljon må holde linjen for å unngå at tyskerne slipper unna.

programme.title: Hitlers siste kamp
programme.desc: Fem måneder etter D-dagen kommer bakkekrigen endelig til tysk jord, og britiske soldater angriper i skyggen av den beryktede Siegfriedlinjen til Hitler.

programme.title: Europas blodigste historier
programme.desc: Tudor-historikeren dr. Suzannah Lipscomb og journalisten Joe Crowley slår seg sammen for å utforske tre av historiens mest mystiske mord. Hvordan endte den legendariske krigskongen Attila huneren opp død, morgenen etter bryllupet sitt? Drepte Rikard III virkelig sine nevøer i Tower of London? Og hvem sto bak det drapet på Juan Borgia – sønn av Romas gudfar, pave Alexander VI?

programme.title: Hitlers siste dager
programme.desc: De siste, mørke dagene av Adolf Hitlers tredje rike når militæret faller sammen og Hitlers forestillinger om uendelig makt smuldrer opp.

programme.title: JFK: De siste timene
programme.desc: Vi kartlegger de kulturelle sjokkbølgene som endret verden etter at president Kennedy ble skutt og drept 22. november 1963.

programme.title: Flyhavarikommisjonen
programme.desc: Like etter avgang begynner det å brenne i UPS flight 6. Idet røyken fyller cockpiten, blir det en kamp mot tiden for å få flyet trygt tilbake.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: Oljearbeideren Steve har eid sin Aston Martin DB6 i over 20 år. Etter at han kjøpte den til en god pris, ble bilen hans stolthet og glede, men da den brøt sammen mislyktes hans forsøk på å reparere sin Aston. Siden den gang har et alvorlig fall og kroniske helseproblemer krevd sitt, og det å skulle restaurere den britiske klassikeren er utenfor hans rekkevidde.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: Bilentusiasten Chris har hatt sin kjære Fiat Dino 71-modell i nesten 25 år. Den tidligere mekanikeren la restaureringen på hylla da han fikk kreft, og nå skal Tim og Fuzz restaurere Dinoen. Tim tar en kjøretur i en av verdens fineste biler, og Fuzz får jobbe med en racingmotor fra Ferrari for aller første gang.

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: Richard bringer inn en forretningskonsulent for å gjøre verkstedet mer effektivt, men ikke alle er enige i forandringene. Cogs prøvekjører den nye måten å jobbe på med en klassisk Fiat, men er dette italienske ikonet virkelig verdt å prøve å redde? Corgi ber om tillatelse til å lage en modell av Richards RS2000 – verkstedets aller første restaureringsprosjekt. Dette PR-kuppet blir fort til en potensiell PR-katastrofe. Cogs kjemper for å ferdigstille BMW-en de har holdt på med i over et år. Konsulenten oppdager den virkelige kostnaden bak tepauser, og en invitasjon til Goodwood pirrer Richards racinglyst.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Thord utvider territoriet sitt, og med et større område følger et større ansvar. Nordpå har Jo Roger overlatt ansvaret til sønnen.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Thord har utvidet området sitt, og nå får han flere utfordringer. I nord må Ole Henrik og Roger hjelpe en lastebil som har veltet.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Når to lastebiler kolliderer i en snøstorm trenger Thord hele teamet og hjelp fra Bjørn for å få fjernet lastebilene og gjenåpne veien. Så kommer enda et anrop inn fra en tenåring som har sklidd ut i grøfta, så Thord må sende datteren Malin og hennes kjæreste Domenic for å hjelpe. I nord får Jo Roger og Raido sjokk når vinsjen glipper mens de hjelper en 50-tonner lastet med stål.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: En tankbil full av avfall sklir baklengs ned en smal, isete bakke, og treffer nesten en snødekt bil. Det er trangt, og Thord må bruke sin lette pickup. Ett feilsteg kan gjøre hele redningsaksjonen til en katastrofe. I Overhalla stikker tauesjåfør Marius innom Jo Rogers garasje på en kjøretur sørover. Men når besøket blir avbrutt av et nødanrop, inviterer Jo Roger Marius med. En ti-minutters kaffepause blir til en lang natts arbeid. Finale.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz begynner å jobbe på en Mercedes SLK fra 2001 med stor affeksjonsverdi for Lili (35) fra Barnsley, som arvet bilen etter å ha mistet foreldrene sine. Dessverre har den lille roadsteren som mora elsket fra den var ny, stått i en garasje med mekaniske problemer, ødelagt fjæring, et slitt interiør og et nedfellbart tak som ikke kan stenges. Mens Fuzz kjemper mot verkstedets gremliner for å få den i kjøreklar stand, drar Tim til Tyskland for å få ekspertråd og bruker en vinkelsliper på en vrakbil for å illustrere utviklingen av kabrioleter. I en kamp mot klokka restaurerer teamet Lilis elskede klenodium i tide til en følelsesladet presentasjon i West End.

programme.title: Flyhavarikommisjonen
programme.desc: Pacific Southwest Airlines Flight 1771 cruiser høyt over Californias landsbygd, på vei til San Francisco fra LAX. Bortsett fra litt turbulens, er den rutinemessige regionale flyvningen begivenhetsløs. Det vil si - til pilotene hører skudd i kabinen. De rapporterer skuddet til tårnet, og like etter gjør flyet et bratt stup og krasjer på et avsidesliggende jorde. Med 43 døde og en mulig forbrytelse om bord, må etterforskere fra både NTSB og FBI samarbeide for å finne ut hva som skjedde, hvem som hadde et motiv og tilgang, og hvem det tiltenkte offeret var.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz har reist til øyene i kanalen for å ta for seg en MK1 Ford Escort Mexico fra 1972. Familien til Gary har kalt inn CAR S.O.S. fordi de tror at Gary vil få ny livsgnist hvis han får Escorten tilbake på veien. Men når bilen kommer inn på verkstedet deres, oppdager guttene at de ikke kan redde ett eneste panel på bilen.

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: Richard Hammond blir tilbudt en stor mulighet når MOD ankommer med Field Marshall Montgomerys Rolls Royce – det første sivile kjøretøyet på stranden etter ilandstigningen på D-dagen. Cogs får i oppgave å komme med et estimat for å restaurere den ikoniske bilen, men uenigheter fører til frykt for at de kan miste hele jobben. Etter å ha gjenopplivet racing-planen sin må Richard fornye førerkortet sitt og setter kursen mot banen på Silverstone for en kjøretest litt utenom det vanlige. I verkstedet har Ant en genial idé for å fikse servostyringen på en moderne klassiker fra 1980-tallet. Finale.

programme.title: Egypts tapte skatter
programme.desc: I denne episoden låser arkeologene opp mysteriene til Egypts mest berømte farao, Tutankhamun. Teknologi avslører metodene til håndverkerne som skapte Tutankhamuns skatter, og vi tar en titt under bandasjene til en 3000 år gammel barnemumie, og avslører overraskende bevis. I mellomtiden gjør et team på jakt etter Tutankhamuns tapte bytte et uventet funn.

Vrakene etter handelsskip avdekker hvordan Venezia ble en handelsmakt, og massegravene på en øy viser at Venezia ble stilt overfor en fiende som selv ikke de kunne beseire.

programme.desc: Tom og Fuzz drar til Cambridgeshire for å hente sin første superbil, en sjelden Ultima-racer fra 1989. De britiskproduserte Ultimaene brøt, i sin tid, verdensrekorder, så hvordan skal gutta takle restaureringen av en så finjustert bil? Særlig en som har samlet støv i en trekkfull garasje i over 30 år. Klarer de å overraske eieren Keith?

programme.title: Hitlers siste kamp
programme.desc: I desember 1944 iverksetter Hitler operasjon "Wacht am Rhein". De tyske stridsvognenes framrykning mot Antwerpen innleder Ardenneroffensiven. Som svar sender USA 505. fallskjermregiment til Ardennene for å sikre en viktig bro, og de må forsvare den mot nazistene med alle midler.

programme.title: Europas blodigste historier
programme.desc: Fra en av Romerrikets mest fryktede keisere til Ungarns Grevinne Dracula. Bloody Tales avslører noen av historiens mest beryktede karakterer og hendelser. I Monstre slår tudor-historiker dr. Suzannah Lipscomb og journalist Joe Crowley seg sammen for å utforske tre ekstraordinære historier. Hvorfor regjerte unge keiser Caligula over Romerriket gjennom frykt og galskap? Hvordan ble en høyt dekorert fransk krigshelt til en produktiv barnemorder? Og hvorfor ble en aldrende, ungarsk enke kjent som grevinne Dracula?

programme.title: Mars: På innsiden av SpaceX
programme.desc: Mars: På innsiden av SpaceX gir oss et innblikk i planleggingen av å frakte mennesker til Mars, og viser oss noen av hemmelighetene bak hvordan ett av verdens mest revolusjonerende selskap drives. Den tre år lange filmingen tar oss bak kulissene når Elon Musk og hans ingeniører opplever nedturer og triumfer, og prøver å utvikle romindustrien raskere enn noen gang.

programme.title: Ultimate Space Telescope
programme.desc: Takket være James Webb-teleskopet får vi endelig svar på noen av astronomiens største mysterier. Verdens mest avanserte og nyskapende teleskop lar oss kikke ut i avkroker av verdensrommet som vi aldri har sett tidligere. Vi får se at utviklingen tok flere tiår og treffer teamet som fanger noen av de beste bildene av verdensrommet som noen gang er tatt.

programme.title: Hitlers siste kamp
programme.desc: Knapt en uke etter at de allierte styrkene gikk i land i Normandie, rykker kaptein Matt Urban og hans enhet, Kompani F, innover i landet mens de allierte får fotfeste i Vest-Europa. Kompani F blir desimert av stridsvognild da kaptein Urban ser at bazooka-skytteren hans blir skutt ned. Han griper bazookaen og skyter mot fiendens stridsvogner, setter dem ut av spill og redder mennene sine. Mens slaget raser videre, blir Urban alvorlig skadet. Til tross for protester blir han sendt til et sykehus i England. Fast bestemt på å vende tilbake til bataljonen sin rømmer han fra sykehuset, haiker til fronten, klatrer om bord i en stridsvogn og leder et dristig angrep gjennom hekklandskapet. Han samler mennene sine for å lede angrepet den første dagen av Operasjon Cobra. Suksessen til kaptein Urban og Operasjon Cobra er avgjørende og skaper en korridor for de allierte styrkene inn i Bretagne.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: CAR S.O.S.-gjengen har tatt på seg å jobbe med en Citroën 2CV, den innovative økonomibilen som ble produsert i over et halvt århundre. Men når guttene kommer for å hente bilen, oppdager de imidlertid at den har blitt fullstendig strippet ned deler med komponenter. Det betyr at de har litt av et puslespill fremfor seg som de må løse.

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: Richard får en skyllebøtte fra MOD etter at Cogs ikke følger ordre under restaureringsarbeidet med Field Marshal Montgomerys uvurderlige Rolls for en avduking under årets 80-årsjubileum for D-dagen. En ny manager gir dem den tøffe nyheten om at dersom de ikke får flere ansatte, har de ingen mulighet til å rekke fristen for D-dagen. Neils forsøk på å promotere et rekrutteringsarrangement blir ødelagt av et hosteanfall på live radio. Ant gjør sitt beste for å redde en søt Fiat Topolino fra 1930-tallet fra å ende hos en skraphandler.

Banebrytende teknologi brukes til å redde en av Egypts største skatter, mens i en eldgammel by avdekker ett team et skjult palass som ble brukt som Ramses’ private hellige sted. I mellomtiden avdekker en sjaktgraving et potensielt stort funn.

programme.title: Et jaktliv med Kristoffer Clausen
programme.desc: Kristoffer Clausen er tilbake med en ny jaktserie. Det handler selvfølgelig om jakt, hovedsakelig i Norge og Sverige, etter våre stedegne arter. Men det blir også innslag av jakt på mer eksotisk vilt.

programme.title: 1000 dager ute
programme.desc: Bengt-Are Barstad har valgt å gi slipp på sine forpliktelser i sivilisasjonen for å leve ut drømmen om et liv så nært naturen som mulig. Med telt i sekken og med sine fire Alaska Huskyer, vandrer Bengt Are nordover mot Finnmark i det tempoet som passer han. Vi får være med på turen og ta del i hans opplevelser på veien, en telttur på 1000 dager!

programme.title: Tilbake til Norge
programme.desc: De har vært på et par fisketurer sammen før. Nå har fiskeentusiasten, forfatteren og tegneren Trond Andersson invitert med seg engelske Chris Yates på et nytt eventyr i Norge. Turmålet er Verdalsvassdraget. Planen er å starte i Vera, for så å fiske seg nedover elva – dit laksen er.

programme.title: Jæger Hansens Villmarkskjøkken
programme.desc: Svein Jæger Hansen tar deg med ut i villmarken, der han lager retter i vakre omgivelser og deler sin lidenskap for mat og friluftsliv.

programme.title: Fiskeskolen Seeberg
programme.desc: Helgelandskysten strekker seg over 200 kilometer, fra lengst nord i Trøndelag og hele veien opp til Salten. I dette fantastiske øyriket finnes det enorme mengder fisk og ekstremt mange gode fiskeplasser. Det er ikke uten grunn at fiskere fra både nær og fjern, innland og utland, trekkes mot dette sagnomsuste stykket norskekyst. Endre Hopland og vår mann i nord Rolf André Lorentsen, fast inventar Espen Olaussen og førstereis Kent André Fordelsen sjekker inn hos Kay-Arne Knutsen og Silje Solbakk Henriksen på Kvarøy Sjøhus. For å gjøre opplevelsen komplett, tjuvstarter Knoll og Tott fra Mo i Rana også ballet på egenhånd, med selve dronninga som targetart. Bli med oss på et eventyrlig fiske i et minst like eventyrlig kystområde.

programme.title: Fuglehundfeber
programme.desc: Velkommen til Fuglehundfeber! Bli med på Bernt og Nemi sin reise fra valp til voksen fuglehund. Få et innblikk i alt det innebærer å få ny fuglehund i hus, grunndressur og trening. Underveis i serien tar vi en prat med dyktige jegere, oppdrettere og jaktprøveentusiaster og får høre deres tanker og filosofier. Vel vitende at det kan være et minefelt. Så kan du der hjemme gjøre opp din egen mening om hva som passer for deg og din hund. Produsert av Bernt Nor og Hooked.

programme.title: Vesterdal
programme.desc: Lars Erik Vesterdal har invitert engasjerte gjester og bedt de ta med egne råvarer. Sammen lager de mat og deler sine historier og erfaringer i møte med naturen.
